Pizza Hut S’pore 10.10 Online Deals: $10 Specials & More this Oct 2026

29 Sep 2026 4:54 PM SGNewsMan Events, Food, Restaurants, Dining, Groceries

STARTED TODAY
Starts1 Oct 2026 (Thu)Ends20 Oct 2026 (Tue)

Pizza Hut S’pore is rolling out a tasty line-up of 10.10 online-exclusive deals from 1 to 20 October 2026, with $10 pizza offers, chicken favourites and $10 off qualifying orders.

All four deals are available through Pizza Hut’s web or app only and run all day while stocks last. The two pizza deals are Online Self Pick-Up only and available on weekdays only. This means there is no $10 pizza deal on 10 or 11 October as of publish time: the $10 Large Pizza runs on 1-2 and 5-9 October, while the $10 Regular Favourite Pizza + Crispy Chicken Fries runs on 12-16 and 19-20 October. The $10-off and $10 chicken offers run from 1-20 October and can also be used for delivery.

  2. 🍕 $10 Large Pizza on Weekdays, 1 – 9 October
  3. 🍗 $10 Regular Pizza + Crispy Chicken Fries on Weekdays, 12 – 20 October
  4. 💰 $10 off with minimum $50 spend
  5. 🍗 10 chicken pieces for $10

🍕 $10 Large Pizza on Weekdays, 1 – 9 October

From 1 to 9 October 2026, selected large pizzas are available for just $10 each on weekdays. This takeaway deal is offered all day while stocks last and is available exclusively through Online Self Pick-Up via web and app.

Dates:1 – 9 October 2026 (Weekdays only)
Time:All day, while stocks last
Pizza Flavours:
  • BBQ Chunky Chic
  • Cheesy Spinach
Channel:Online Self Pick-Up only (Web & App)

🍗 $10 Regular Pizza + Crispy Chicken Fries on Weekdays, 12 – 20 October

The second weekday special runs from 12 to 20 October 2026. A Regular Favourite Pizza plus Crispy Chicken Fries goes for just $10, offering a convenient pizza-and-side combination for an affordable meal.

Dates:12 – 20 October 2026 (Weekdays only)
Time:All day, while stocks last
Pizza Flavours:
  • Chic Ham ‘N’ Shroom
  • Simply Cheese
  • BBQ Chunky Chic
  • Cheese ‘N’ Chic
  • Very Beefy
  • Cheesy Spinach
Channel:Online Self Pick-Up only (Web & App)

💰 $10 off with minimum $50 spend

For a larger Pizza Hut feast, there is also $10 off the total bill with a minimum $50 spend from 1 to 20 October 2026. This all-day promotion is available for both delivery and Online Self Pick-Up via web and app, while stocks last.

Dates:1 – 20 October 2026
Time:All day, while stocks last
Promo Code:1010OFF
Channel:Delivery & Online Self Pick-Up only (Web & App)

💡 Enter promo code 1010OFF when placing an online order of at least $50.

🍗 10 chicken pieces for $10

Chicken fans can pick up 10pcs Sweet ‘N’ Spicy Drumlets or 10pcs Honey Roasted Wings for $10 with a minimum $15 spend. The promotion runs all day from 1 to 20 October 2026, while stocks last, for delivery and Online Self Pick-Up orders made through the web or app.

Dates:1 – 20 October 2026
Time:All day, while stocks last
Minimum Spend:$15
Promo Code:1010CHIX
Channel:Delivery & Online Self Pick-Up only (Web & App)

💡 Worth noting: The $10 chicken price does not mean a $10 standalone order, as this promotion requires a minimum $15 spend. Pizza Hut currently lists 10pcs Honey Roasted Wings and 10pcs Sweet ‘N’ Spicy Drumlets at $15.90 each, so the promotional item price is $5.90 lower – about 37% off – before taking the minimum-spend requirement into account.

Take note that promo codes cannot be stacked. Only one promo code can be applied per order, so 1010OFF and 1010CHIX cannot be used together in the same transaction. Choose the promo code that best suits the order before checking out.

For delivery orders, Pizza Hut’s official FAQ lists a $5 delivery surcharge, charged separately from the food-order minimum. A $50 minimum delivery food order applies to Sentosa, Changi Airport Cargo Complex, Jurong Island, Tuas South and Aviation Park.

Pizza Hut’s previous long-running Takeaway Pocket Pleasers promotion also lists Large pizzas from $10, but with a different flavour selection. The most recent expired $10 Large Pizza promotion in August-September 2026 offered more Favourite flavours and also allowed walk-in takeaway; see the previous $10 Large Pizza promotion for historical comparison.

With different deals covering pizzas, sides, chicken and larger orders, Pizza Hut’s 10.10 promotion provides several ways to stretch the dining budget this October. 🍕 Check the applicable dates and ordering channel before placing an order, as the pizza specials are weekday-only and all offers are subject to availability and applicable terms and conditions.

Head to the official Pizza Hut Singapore ordering site to check live availability and complete an order. For self-collection, the official Pizza Hut store locator can be used to find a suitable collection point. Deals remain subject to their respective dates, stock availability and checkout terms.
